name: EPIC 206507309
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 6.7 solar radii and 1.45 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206507309 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.6907 (16th-84th percentiles 6.463273-6.914521), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,513 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.45 solar masses and 6.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,008 K at its surface.
